about: Let Emirati patients, and children of Emirati women, who cannot get treatment in the UAE apply for care at accredited facilities abroad.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Emirati patients and children of Emirati women
The treatment cannot be obtained in the UAE
documents: Medical report from the UAE issued within the last 3 months
timing: You are told if the request is approved or rejected
channels: TAMM website or app (sign in with UAE PASS)
